name: Jack Daw
text: Fly South. Start of Combat: steal 2 Attack from the enemy across.
golden_text: Fly South. Start of Combat: steal 4 Attack from the enemy across.
details: The steal lasts the fight. With nothing across, nothing happens. An enemy cannot go below 0 Attack.
